events.title: 미국에서 태어나다
events.description: 미국에서 태어났다. 어린 시절에 관한 기록은 거의 남아 있지 않다.
events.description_en: He was born in the United States. Little is recorded about his early life.

events.title: 노스이스턴대에서 전기공학 학사를 마치다
events.title_en: He finished an electrical engineering degree at Northeastern
events.description_en: He earned a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering at Northeastern University.

events.title: MIT에서 박사학위를 받다
events.title_en: He earned his PhD at MIT
events.description_en: He earned his PhD at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

events.title: 카네기멜런대에 레그랩을 세우다
events.title_en: He founded the Leg Lab at Carnegie Mellon
events.description: 카네기멜런대에 레그랩을 세우고 뛰고 균형 잡는 다리 로봇을 연구하기 시작했다.
events.description_en: He founded the Leg Laboratory at Carnegie Mellon University and began researching legged robots that could hop and balance.

events.title: 레그랩을 MIT로 옮겨 이끌다
events.title_en: He moved the Leg Lab to MIT and led it
events.description: 레그랩을 MIT로 옮겨 1995년까지 소장을 맡았다. 이 시기의 연구가 동적 로봇의 과학적 토대를 놓았다.
events.description_en: He moved the Leg Lab to MIT and directed it until 1995. The research from this period laid the scientific groundwork for dynamic robots.

events.title: 보스턴 다이내믹스를 창업하다
events.description_en: He founded the robotics company Boston Dynamics.

events.title: 사족보행 로봇 빅도그를 선보이다
events.title_en: He unveiled the quadruped robot BigDog
events.description: 국방고등연구계획국의 지원으로 만든 사족보행 로봇 빅도그를 선보였다. 험지에서도 균형을 잃지 않는 모습으로 주목받았다.
events.description_en: He unveiled BigDog, a quadruped robot built with funding from the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency. It drew attention for staying balanced on rough terrain.

events.title: 구글에 인수되다
events.title_en: The company was acquired by Google
events.description: 보스턴 다이내믹스가 구글에 인수됐다. 로봇공학과 머신러닝에 대한 구글의 관심이 배경이었다.
events.description_en: Boston Dynamics was acquired by Google, reflecting the company's interest in robotics and machine learning.

events.title: 소프트뱅크로 넘어가다
events.title_en: The company was sold to SoftBank
events.description_en: Google sold Boston Dynamics to SoftBank.

events.title: 현대자동차그룹이 지분을 인수하다
events.title_en: Hyundai Motor Group acquired a controlling stake
events.description: 현대자동차그룹이 소프트뱅크로부터 보스턴 다이내믹스 지분 80%를 인수했다.
events.description_en: Hyundai Motor Group acquired an 80 percent stake in Boston Dynamics from SoftBank.

events.title: AI 인스티튜트를 세워 의장을 맡다
events.title_en: He founded the AI Institute and became its chair
events.description: 차세대 지능형 로봇의 기초 연구를 위한 AI 인스티튜트를 세우고 의장을 맡았다.
events.description_en: He founded the AI Institute, a research organization focused on the foundations of next-generation intelligent robots, and became its chair.
